::: {.callout-note}
## Learn from a completed map

1. Choose a scenario to see how work, queues, and handoffs appear on a Current State Map.
2. Compare the data boxes below the map; they contain the evidence used to find waste.
3. Follow the walkthrough to identify bottlenecks, quality failures, and delays.
4. When you are ready, open the [interactive workspace](./current-primary.qmd) to map your own process.
:::

## Explore three current-state scenarios

Use the scenario selector to compare examples from physical production, software delivery, and shared services. Each map is a simplified teaching example rather than a future-state recommendation.

```{ojs}
  const current_example_svg_namespace = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const current_example_root = document.createElement("div");
  current_example_root.className = "current-example-tutorial";

  const current_example_control = document.createElement("div");
  current_example_control.className = "current-example-control";
  const current_example_label = document.createElement("label");
  current_example_label.htmlFor = "current-example-scenario";
  current_example_label.textContent = "Example scenario";
  const current_example_select = document.createElement("select");
  current_example_select.id = "current-example-scenario";
  for (const [current_example_key, current_example_scenario] of Object.entries(
    current_example_scenarios
  )) {
    const current_example_option = document.createElement("option");
    current_example_option.value = current_example_key;
    current_example_option.textContent = current_example_scenario.label;
    current_example_select.append(current_example_option);
  }
  const current_example_status = document.createElement("span");
  current_example_status.className = "current-example-status";
  current_example_status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  current_example_control.append(
    current_example_label,
    current_example_select,
    current_example_status
  );

  const current_example_content = document.createElement("div");
  current_example_root.append(current_example_control, current_example_content);

  function current_example_svg_element(current_example_name, current_example_attributes) {
    const current_example_element = document.createElementNS(
      current_example_svg_namespace,
      current_example_name
    );
    for (const [current_example_attribute, current_example_value] of Object.entries(
      current_example_attributes
    )) {
      current_example_element.setAttribute(current_example_attribute, current_example_value);
    }
    return current_example_element;
  }

  function current_example_render_map(current_example_scenario) {
    const current_example_map = document.createElement("div");
    current_example_map.className = "current-example-map";
    const current_example_svg = current_example_svg_element("svg", {
      viewBox: "0 0 1000 290",
      role: "img",
      "aria-label": `${current_example_scenario.label} sample Current State Map`
    });
    const current_example_title = current_example_svg_element("title", {});
    current_example_title.textContent =
      `${current_example_scenario.label} flow with process steps and queues`;
    current_example_svg.append(current_example_title);

    const current_example_marker = current_example_svg_element("marker", {
      id: "current-example-arrow",
      markerWidth: "10",
      markerHeight: "10",
      refX: "8",
      refY: "3",
      orient: "auto",
      markerUnits: "strokeWidth"
    });
    const current_example_arrow = current_example_svg_element("path", {
      d: "M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z",
      fill: "currentColor"
    });
    current_example_marker.append(current_example_arrow);
    const current_example_defs = current_example_svg_element("defs", {});
    current_example_defs.append(current_example_marker);
    current_example_svg.append(current_example_defs);

    current_example_scenario.nodes.forEach((current_example_node, current_example_index) => {
      const current_example_x = 25 + current_example_index * 245;
      if (current_example_index > 0) {
        const current_example_line = current_example_svg_element("line", {
          x1: String(current_example_x - 50),
          y1: "95",
          x2: String(current_example_x - 12),
          y2: "95",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          "stroke-width": "3",
          "marker-end": "url(#current-example-arrow)"
        });
        current_example_svg.append(current_example_line);

        const current_example_triangle = current_example_svg_element("path", {
          d: `M${current_example_x - 72},150 l18,32 h-36 z`,
          fill: "#fbbf24",
          stroke: "#7c5d00",
          "stroke-width": "2"
        });
        const current_example_queue = current_example_svg_element("text", {
          x: String(current_example_x - 72),
          y: "202",
          "text-anchor": "middle",
          fill: "currentColor",
          "font-size": "14"
        });
        current_example_queue.textContent =
          current_example_scenario.queues[current_example_index - 1];
        current_example_svg.append(current_example_triangle, current_example_queue);
      }

      const current_example_box = current_example_svg_element("rect", {
        x: String(current_example_x),
        y: "45",
        width: "180",
        height: "100",
        rx: "8",
        fill: "#e8f1fb",
        stroke: "#245b8a",
        "stroke-width": "2"
      });
      const current_example_name = current_example_svg_element("text", {
        x: String(current_example_x + 90),
        y: "88",
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        fill: "#16324a",
        "font-size": "17",
        "font-weight": "700"
      });
      const current_example_name_parts = current_example_node.name.split(" ");
      const current_example_name_first = current_example_svg_element("tspan", {
        x: String(current_example_x + 90),
        dy: "0"
      });
      const current_example_name_second = current_example_svg_element("tspan", {
        x: String(current_example_x + 90),
        dy: "22"
      });
      const current_example_split = Math.ceil(current_example_name_parts.length / 2);
      current_example_name_first.textContent =
        current_example_name_parts.slice(0, current_example_split).join(" ");
      current_example_name_second.textContent =
        current_example_name_parts.slice(current_example_split).join(" ");
      current_example_name.append(current_example_name_first);
      if (current_example_name_second.textContent) {
        current_example_name.append(current_example_name_second);
      }
      current_example_svg.append(current_example_box, current_example_name);
    });

    const current_example_legend = current_example_svg_element("text", {
      x: "25",
      y: "255",
      fill: "currentColor",
      "font-size": "15"
    });
    current_example_legend.textContent =
      "▲ Queue or inventory between process steps — larger values indicate accumulating work.";
    current_example_svg.append(current_example_legend);
    current_example_map.append(current_example_svg);
    return current_example_map;
  }

  function current_example_render_data(current_example_scenario) {
    const current_example_section = document.createElement("section");
    current_example_section.className = "current-example-panel";
    const current_example_heading = document.createElement("h3");
    current_example_heading.textContent = "Process data boxes";
    const current_example_help = document.createElement("p");
    current_example_help.textContent =
      "Read each data box together with the queue immediately before its process step.";
    const current_example_grid = document.createElement("div");
    current_example_grid.className = "current-example-data-grid";

    for (const current_example_node of current_example_scenario.nodes) {
      const current_example_box = document.createElement("article");
      current_example_box.className = "current-example-data-box";
      const current_example_name = document.createElement("h4");
      current_example_name.textContent = current_example_node.name;
      const current_example_list = document.createElement("dl");
      for (const [current_example_metric, current_example_value] of Object.entries(
        current_example_node.metrics
      )) {
        const current_example_term = document.createElement("dt");
        current_example_term.textContent = current_example_metric;
        const current_example_description = document.createElement("dd");
        current_example_description.textContent = current_example_value;
        current_example_list.append(current_example_term, current_example_description);
      }
      current_example_box.append(current_example_name, current_example_list);
      current_example_grid.append(current_example_box);
    }
    current_example_section.append(
      current_example_heading,
      current_example_help,
      current_example_grid
    );
    return current_example_section;
  }

  function current_example_render_waste(current_example_scenario) {
    const current_example_section = document.createElement("section");
    current_example_section.className = "current-example-panel";
    const current_example_heading = document.createElement("h3");
    current_example_heading.textContent = "Waste signals in this map";
    const current_example_grid = document.createElement("div");
    current_example_grid.className = "current-example-waste-grid";
    const current_example_kinds = [
      ["bottleneck", "🛑 Bottleneck / high lead time"],
      ["quality", "⚠️ Quality failure"],
      ["wait", "⏳ Wait time / delay"]
    ];
    for (const [current_example_kind, current_example_title_text] of current_example_kinds) {
      const current_example_card = document.createElement("article");
      current_example_card.className = "current-example-waste";
      current_example_card.dataset.kind = current_example_kind;
      const current_example_title_element = document.createElement("h4");
      current_example_title_element.textContent = current_example_title_text;
      const current_example_text = document.createElement("p");
      current_example_text.textContent = current_example_scenario.waste[current_example_kind];
      current_example_card.append(current_example_title_element, current_example_text);
      current_example_grid.append(current_example_card);
    }
    current_example_section.append(current_example_heading, current_example_grid);
    return current_example_section;
  }

  function current_example_render() {
    const current_example_scenario =
      current_example_scenarios[current_example_select.value];
    const current_example_intro = document.createElement("section");
    current_example_intro.className = "current-example-panel";
    const current_example_heading = document.createElement("h3");
    current_example_heading.textContent = current_example_scenario.label;
    const current_example_summary = document.createElement("p");
    current_example_summary.textContent = current_example_scenario.summary;
    current_example_intro.append(
      current_example_heading,
      current_example_summary,
      current_example_render_map(current_example_scenario)
    );
    current_example_content.replaceChildren(
      current_example_intro,
      current_example_render_data(current_example_scenario),
      current_example_render_waste(current_example_scenario)
    );
    current_example_status.textContent =
      `Showing ${current_example_scenario.label}.`;
  }

  current_example_select.addEventListener("change", current_example_render);
  current_example_render();
  return current_example_root;
}
```

## Guided walkthrough

::: {.callout-tip}
## 1. Establish the map boundary

Confirm the first and last process steps for one product or service family. Follow what happens today, including informal workarounds, rather than drawing the intended procedure.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## 2. Compare queue size with process capacity

Look immediately upstream of each process. A growing queue, long lead time, or cycle time above the pace of demand identifies a likely constraint.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## 3. Trace quality problems to their source

High scrap, code-error, or data-error percentages show where quality is detected—not necessarily where the problem begins. Add rework loops and ask which earlier step creates the defect.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## 4. Separate touch time from waiting

Compare the time spent actively working with total elapsed lead time. Approval gates, funding holds, permissions, batches, and departmental handoffs often explain the difference.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## 5. Validate before designing improvements

Review the map with the people who perform the work. Confirm the observations, record missing evidence, and only then prioritize changes for a Future State Map.
:::

## Map your own system

Take the patterns you identified here into the interactive builder. Start from a simple process script, refine the flow in Draw.io, and record a timestamped data box for each process node.
